scenarioProfiles.description: Research current seams and lineage, model boundaries, challenge the proposal, and evolve through reversible increments.
scenarioProfiles.label: Architecture governance and evolution

scenarioProfiles.description: Triage a defect, reproduce it, confirm root cause, optionally experiment, make one focused fix, and add a regression guard.
gates: No production fix before root-cause evidence
Uncertain fix strategies are tested one variable at a time
scenarioProfiles.label: Bug fix

scenarioProfiles.description: Recover an end-to-end business path including entry points, branches, persistence, events, remote calls, and failure paths.
gates: Happy path and meaningful failure branches are traced
Business terms are not inferred from names alone
scenarioProfiles.label: Business flow investigation

scenarioProfiles.description: Recover current behavior and domain meaning before specifying and implementing a business capability.
gates: Domain ownership or lifecycle changes require approval
scenarioProfiles.label: Complex domain feature

scenarioProfiles.description: Coordinate contracts, ownership, rollout, compatibility, and verification across multiple services.
gates: Contracts are versioned or backward compatible
scenarioProfiles.label: Cross-service change

scenarioProfiles.description: Design expand-migrate-contract phases, checkpoints, reconciliation, rollback or forward-fix, and retirement.
scenarioProfiles.label: Data migration

scenarioProfiles.description: Use a reduced but explicit gate: triage, reproduce, confirm root cause, make the smallest reversible fix, verify, review waivers, and assess delivery readiness.
scenarioProfiles.label: Emergency hotfix

scenarioProfiles.description: Trace a field across UI, API, DTOs, transforms, persistence, events, and remote calls without changing behavior.
gates: Unknown hops are reported rather than guessed
scenarioProfiles.label: Field lineage investigation

scenarioProfiles.description: Mitigate customer impact first, preserve evidence, find root cause, apply a bounded correction, verify recovery, and require a postmortem.
gates: Mitigation and root-cause correction are recorded separately
Emergency changes require explicit delivery approval
scenarioProfiles.label: Production incident response

scenarioProfiles.description: Map a destination through decision frontiers, execute multiple bounded changes, preserve lineage, and retire old paths safely.
gates: Historical lineage and retirement criteria exist
scenarioProfiles.label: Long-running migration program

scenarioProfiles.description: Establish a measurable baseline, instrument boundaries, test one hypothesis at a time, and prove the improvement.
scenarioProfiles.label: Performance investigation

scenarioProfiles.description: Challenge demand, identify the narrowest valuable wedge, define success, then move into product and engineering design.
gates: Target user and status quo are concrete
scenarioProfiles.label: Product discovery

scenarioProfiles.description: Strengthen an existing implementation through targeted review, tests, QA, and evidence without inventing new product scope.
gates: Quality findings are tied to an explicit contract or observed behavior
Fixes remain within the hardening scope
scenarioProfiles.label: Quality hardening

scenarioProfiles.description: Pause promotion, inspect delivery evidence, choose rollback or forward-fix, and verify environment health.
gates: Rollback capability is checked instead of assumed
scenarioProfiles.label: Release or deployment failure

scenarioProfiles.description: Design public interfaces first, preserve compatibility, verify consumers, and publish a traceable artifact.
scenarioProfiles.label: Shared SDK or library

scenarioProfiles.description: Deliver a focused feature through lightweight specification, design, planning, implementation, and verification.
scenarioProfiles.label: Small, well-understood feature

scenarioProfiles.description: Answer where code, rules, ownership, or behavior live without creating a change or modifying source.
gates: Every load-bearing statement cites code or a formal artifact
scenarioProfiles.label: Read-only system query

scenarioProfiles.description: Compare uncertain approaches with explicit candidates, one-variable trials, measurable evidence, cleanup, and a bounded conclusion.
gates: Question and success metrics are explicit
Candidates are compared under equivalent conditions
Experiment code does not silently become production code
scenarioProfiles.label: Technical experiment

scenarioProfiles.description: Align user intent and interaction design, implement accessible slices, and verify affected flows in a real browser.
gates: Browser evidence follows project policy rather than global magic thresholds
scenarioProfiles.label: UI and UX feature

route.reason: Domain meaning, ownership, lifecycle, or invariant changed.
The change is bounded to implementation detail and does not reopen upstream decisions.
The remaining implementation choice requires measured evidence.
Only task structure, dependency order, or delivery sequencing changed.
Product goal or user outcome changed and requires a new decision.
Current-system reality changed or is no longer trustworthy.
Scope, acceptance criteria, or non-goals changed.
A technical constraint invalidated the selected implementation approach.
